text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P99 latency spike detected for Hosted API route /v1/generate (model=rwd-13b, path=continuous-batching). p99 crossed 3s threshold at 2026-03-14T21:12:31Z. Auto-escalation: paging on-call.

Anita L.: I'm oncall, seeing a ton of alerts in the dashboard. p95 is okay-ish but p99 has shot up. Any initial context?

Jamal K.: pulling logs + histogram. Looks like a small subset of requests are getting stuck in the continuous batching queue and waiting ~2.5-4s before being scheduled. Sequence length distribution shows a bimodal pattern: short (<64) and very long (>2048) mixed in same batch.

Priya S.: that matches the scheduler fairness bug I was looking at — when we mix short and long sequences the KV-cache/kv-eviction and runtime slot assignment sometimes prioritizes throughput and ends up biasing against newer short requests. Continuous batching coalesces them into one batch and long ones stall the head (head-of-line).

Marco (CS): Customer impact? Any customers seeing errors or timeouts?

Anita L.: No 5xx spike, mostly tail latency; some streaming stalls reported by a couple customers integrating realtime chat. I filed a quick CS note.

Jamal K.: dshards service metrics: queue_length spiked from median 2 -> 12 for the affected pool, scheduler_latency p99 ~ 1.8s, plus runtime execution add'l 1.2s for long sequences.

Priya S.: mitigation plan: immediate short-term toggle to disable continuous batching for this model/pool OR force smaller max_batch_size and enable sequence-length bucketing. I can push a config change to reduce max_batch_size to 8 and set scheduler to weighted fairness (favor small seqs). That should reduce tail.

Anita L.: do it. If the toggle is quick, prefer disable continuous batching globally for this pool and then we can re-enable after deploy with improved scheduler.

Priya S.: executing change via control-plane API.

Priya S.: ```
# api call to runtime-control
POST /api/v1/pools/rwd-hosted-13b/config
{
  "continuous_batching": false,
  "max_batch_size": 8,
  "scheduling_policy": "weighted-fair",
  "bucket_by_sequence_length": true
}
```

deploy-bot: config-update acknowledged, rolling update to pool rwd-hosted-13b started (job id: jobs/20260314-889).

Jamal K.: watching metrics: queue_length dropping, scheduler_latency p99 down to ~450ms after first 30s. Streaming stalls reported by customers decreased.

Anita L.: Good. Keep changes in place for 30m then we can do a controlled re-enable with a small % canary. Priya, please open a PR for the scheduler fix and link to this thread.

Priya S.: Will do. Quick logs from the runtime show repeated batching windows where an early long-seq occupies the batch and the rest wait. Example trace ids: trace-0x3a7b, trace-0x3a8f. I'll attach traces to the PR.

Marco (CS): I'm messaging the affected customers with a brief note: we saw transient stalls for streaming responses; we reduced queueing by adjusting scheduling and will follow up with timeline and next steps.

Jamal K.: small follow-up: disabling continuous batching increases per-token cost slightly for small requests; we'll track cost delta. Also need an alert on mixed sequence-length batch ratio > 0.25 so we can auto-bucket earlier.

Priya S.: Action items (taking):
- PR: scheduler fairness change + unit tests for mixed seqs (Priya)
- Add auto-bucketing heuristic to control-plane (Priya/Jamal)
- Canary plan to re-enable continuous batching at 5% -> 20% (Anita/Priya)
- Alert rule: mixed seq ratio and p99 queueing (Jamal)
- Customer comms + postmortem (Marco/Anita)

Anita L.: Handoff: I'll stay on until 22:00 UTC, then hand to Jamal for overnight. Jamal, if p99 creeps back above 2s, escalate to pager rotation A.

Jamal K.: noted. I'll prepare a runbook snippet for this exact symptom: "continuous-batching head-of-line due to mixed sequence lengths" with troubleshooting steps (metrics to inspect, quick toggles, cost tradeoffs).

Priya S.: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5173 - includes deterministic scheduling policy + tests. I'll roll a canary when CI passes.

deploy-bot: rollout completed for pool rwd-hosted-13b, config state=active (jobs/20260314-889).

Jamal K.: p99 now 420ms, p95 ~85ms. Cost uptick ~3% for small requests — acceptable short-term.

Marco (CS): customers notified. No escalations so far.

Anita L.: Thanks team. We'll write the postmortem and include recommended defaults: enable bucket_by_sequence_length=true on host pools, add a safeguard to prevent huge long-seq from being coalesced with many small ones, and a metric to trigger auto-bucketing at runtime.

Priya S.: I'll add scheduled follow-ups: implement per-pool max_continuous_batching_window and improve scheduler fairness.

Anita L.: Closing live incident. Creating postmortem ticket and tagging this thread. If anyone sees regressions, ping here. :thumbsup:
